description: Machine-readable facts about the ewe project. Curated mirror of the vault's reference sheets; validated by .vault/vault-check.sh. Humans read the Markdown notes; agents read this.

repos.name: ewe
repos.role: desktop environment + ewe package + CLI tools + design system

repos.name: ewe-plugin-cast
repos.role: add-on: Cast to TV (shell end of ewe-castd)

rules: ewe-conf is the only writer of ewe.conf
secrets never enter ewe.conf or any synced file
layer-shell surfaces stay in the shell
every CLI tool prints JSON and exits 0
nothing else has a sync button
never edit generated files or deployed ~/.config
arch only, pacman only, no partial upgrades
state that outlives the shell lives outside the shell
the design system is the source of truth for every surface

cli_tools.job: software manager + add-ons catalogue (not in ewe/bin)

gotchas: qs ipc call <t> show collides with the qs ipc show subcommand and no-ops - bind to toggle
ewe-plugin install/enable run hyprctl reload and set/place poke plugins reload against the CURRENT HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE/WAYLAND_DISPLAY even with --no-restart - unset both from a harness
qs matches plugins reload by config path: in the nested harness use driver.sh ipc plugins reload

rfc_status.status: superseded for account (RFC-005); Google extras remain

rfc_status.topic: does not exist in the repos
rfc_status.status: absent - do not hunt for it
phases A+B built; C field-proof pending; text only in ewe-cast/README
accepted 2026-09-02; nextcloud branch across 5 repos; merges as one wave

sync_contract.guard: If-Match on the ETag recorded at the last sync (412 = remote newer); a moved ETag over bytes this machine last pushed/pulled or has in flight (sync.json sha256/pending) is adopted, not a conflict (D12)
sync_contract.owner: ewe-sync only - nothing else has a sync button
sync_contract.status_conflict: sync-status answers conflict: remote-newer | remote-exists | null, and remote_is_this_machine; error is the transport error only
sync_contract.machine_id: ewe.conf.meta.json carries machine_id = sha256('ewe-conf:' + /etc/machine-id)[:16] (never the raw id) beside the hostname
sync_contract.stamp_missing: a push whose file landed but whose meta stamp was refused is ok with warning stamp-missing (recorded)

known_limits: Komble: not yet run against a live pacman
ewe-cast Chromecast: seconds of latency (HLS); true mirroring is a future milestone
ewe-repo: packages unsigned (SigLevel = Optional TrustAll) until signing ships
ewe-sync: cannot create Nextcloud accounts; no selective sync inside a pair; no bandwidth limits
Google Gmail: restricted scope - <=100 test users without a CASA audit
0.25.0-beta unreleased: Welcome Add-ons step, Shell.toggleOverview/primaryScreenName/dockItems/closePopups, VERSION bump and 90-postcheck 1.4.1-2.1 were still being integrated on 2026-10-04
Komble Add-ons catalogue and ewe-settings add-on awareness are dev-mock tested only (no real Tauri window yet)
quiet-lid fix (A2) not yet verified on real laptop hardware

addons.model: D1-D8 (2026-10-04, ewe 0.25.0-beta): first-party plugins vendored in the payload, not installed on a fresh machine, one-time migration for upgraders. Called 'add-ons' in 0.25.0; one name 'plugins' since D9 (2026-10-10)
addons.payload: plugins/<id>/ + plugins/bundle.json (repo, commit, version, default, migrate) written by scripts/vendor-plugins.sh
addons.install: ewe-plugin install <id> | Komble --addons (page 'Plugins') | Welcome Plugins step
addons.migrate_marker: ~/.local/state/ewe/addons-migrated (JSON list of considered ids; local, never synced)
addons.preinstalled: shell core (bar, launcher, Overview, Quick settings basics, notifications, lock, OSD, polkit, Welcome), ewe-settings, Komble, ewe-sync
addons.keybind_rule: manifest keybind target must be the plugin id or one of its ipcAliases (apiVersion >= 3); ipcAliases are ewe.* only
addons.system_install_command: bash /usr/share/ewe/install.sh --no-packages as the user (exits 2 under sudo)
addons.options: Komble Options dialog (Settings, In the bar, On the desktop); komble --options=<id> (D10)
addons.show_in_bar: ewe-plugin bar <id> on|off -> desktop.bar.show."plugin:<id>"; manifest barWidget/barStatus defaultShown, toggle (D10)
addons.setting_legacy: first-party settings may declare legacy: '<ewe.conf key>' whose value stands until set (Dock autohide/icon_size <- desktop.dock.*)
